read.en: ASML fell 6.9% on Oct 22 to $1,560.54, trading between $1,555.94 and $1,628.20 on volume 1.4 times its 20-day average. It is below the falling 5-day ($1,631.3), 10-day ($1,671.3) and 30-day ($1,717.4) averages, the rising 100-day ($1,749.4) and now the rising 200-day ($1,586.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,789.84), and RSI is 34.

The drop broke the $1,650, $1,613–1,619 and $1,594 (Oct 15 low) supports. Resistance is $1,586–1,594 (200-day, Oct 15 low), then $1,613–1,631 (Oct 20 low, 5-day) and $1,671 (10-day). Support is $1,556 (Oct 22 low), then $1,530.6 (Jul 29 low) and $1,441 (May 19 low). A close back above $1,594 would target $1,631; a close below $1,530 would open $1,441.
